<h2 class="section-title">India National Politics</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Opposition protest:</strong> INDIA bloc MPs marched from Parliament to the Election Commission headquarters to demand the resignation of CEC Gyanesh Kumar, alleging irregularities in the voter list and the Special Intensive Revision (SIR) exercise.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I1</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I3</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I6</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I40</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I44</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Supreme Court intervention:</strong> The Supreme Court has sought records from the Election Commission regarding changes to Form 6, with the Chief Justice of India clarifying that the Court did not approve the modified form and asserting its authority to annul unilateral ECI orders.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I17</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I19</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I20</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I22</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMizgFBVV95cUxOYnM1UzdpRmFLcDJkbTJXa3dfZldFUmh4cjRCdF9sMjVrQ1dNX1Fmems1dkQ4b1RIdlFxbFdKT3F4bWU0SzdDUlgzTE1LMkF0TVptVEJZbUN3OUN2Xy0taFg4UWVRREJOZWpQUm16UXp0c2luWjdhS2F1S2EwUy00MnN1ZUZubkJmM3V6bndoc2JqLXlYaFFNVEo0LS16bVdoQWxtc3RWT0c5ZDBNMGdxYXBMVFFDbF9kVTkyaDdyQnBxczY1VW51ZFEtT2RIdw?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I23</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>UP Rajya Sabha polls:</strong> The Samajwadi Party has decided against fielding a third candidate for the Uttar Pradesh Rajya Sabha elections, clearing the path for the BJP to secure 8 of the 10 available seats.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I24</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">I25</a></span></li>
</ul>

<h2 class="section-title">Policy and Institutions</h2>

<ul class="digest-points">
  <li><strong>Legal immunity debate:</strong> The Supreme Court remarked that the legal immunity granted to Election Commissioners under the 2023 Act does not extend to the level of protection afforded to judges.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMivgFBVV95cUxObWZQOUtoSXVJcjRnWDJZYmJTdnRYYjhQdHJkLUQ4d2UtQmFEN05XakNkaWVtQWJvZUpmY3N0eER4VkZuY0VhRnpkUVZfUjhCTTNvS0JhalpzUGVCcTRkd1paSkp4cXJDVzh4cGdDenhIaGc4dWxIOGs5ZU14QlRzc0pxakRrbVNPOHdNVDJTODh2MVYtcF9rRUJJcDlITlFiS0UtWlZySzFTMUtQRG1WYlV5ZmdUV3BoWmJaMmhR?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W35</a> <a href="https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMisAFBVV95cUxNZ1NMdktneXBHN0xHSHIyeUhNd2w0ZkM2LUo3czFnRDhjNUNSSDE0SXRSOW1KbjkxcmVUWGQwTmx6THNWQlVQVHg2Q0p4SEFwb2RCMGZ2WEFRZ0J2YldteWNvb29zNHFEZjZmcmJfdXFLX0IwSFFTT3cyMW1mWnA4LUpvQ3FIallVWV85WGpWRThSRUY5OU1FYl9COU90d0hsM25oSkdYN244WlRZaV9MYQ?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W9</a></span></li>
  <li><strong>Tripura election results:</strong> The Tipra Motha Party (TMP) secured a decisive victory in the TTAADC Village Committee elections, winning 3,428 out of 4,594 seats, while the BJP secured 859.<span class="source-chips"><a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W32</a> <a href="https://news.google.?oc=5&amp;hl=en-US&amp;gl=US&amp;ceid=US%3Aen" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">W38</a></span></li>
</ul>
